events.command:
/bin/bash -lc 'curl -sS --fail -H "x-api-key: $(<"$GALAXY_API_KEY_FILE")" "$GALAXY_URL/api/datasets/f9cad7b01a4721359b80b20d9b264350/display" -o /workspace/blast_pan_sample.txt && python3 - <<'"'PY'
from collections import Counter,defaultdict
rows=[]
for line in open('/workspace/blast_pan_sample.txt'):
    p=line.rstrip('\\n').split('\\t')
    if len(p)>=8:
        rows.append(p)
# group by query, best evalue per query; show top hit title and counts for each
for q in sorted(set(r[0] for r in rows)):
    hits=[r for r in rows if r[0]==q]
    best=min(hits, key=lambda x: float(x[4]))
    bests=[r for r in hits if r[4]==best[4]]
    print('\\n', q, 'num_hits', len(hits), 'best_evalue', best[4], 'best_pident', best[2], 'best_len', best[3])
    cnt=Counter(r[5].split(' ',1)[0]+' '+r[5].split(' ',2)[1] if len(r[5].split(' ',1))>1 else r[5] for r in bests)
    for t,c in cnt.most_common(5): print('   ', c, t)
PY"
